Richard F. Burton (1821–1890), Vikram and the Vampire; or, Tales of Hindu Devilry, adapted from the Sanskrit, 1870. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution.
